  {"step":2,"file":"src/hb-subset-plan.cc","function":"hb_subset_plan_create","line":183,"var":"plan->desubroutinize","code":"plan->desubroutinize = input->desubroutinize;","note":"The input flag is copied into the plan and controls whether CFF subroutines are flattened or subsetted."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/hb-subset.cc","function":"_subset_table","line":139,"var":"table","code":"table->subset (plan)","note":"The CFF1 table-specific subset routine is dispatched from the generic subset loop."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/hb-ot-cff1-table.hh","function":"subset","line":1275,"var":"cff_prime","code":"if (hb_subset_cff1 (plan, &cff_prime)) { ... }","note":"The CFF1 subset path allocates a new blob for the rewritten table and prepares to add it to the destination face."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/hb-subset-cff1.cc","function":"hb_subset_cff1","line":1103,"var":"cff_blob","code":"hb_sanitize_context_t().reference_table<CFF::cff1> (plan->source)","note":"The original attacker font bytes are re-referenced as the CFF1 source blob for parsing and rewriting."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/hb-subset-cff1.cc","function":"_hb_subset_cff1","line":1065,"var":"cff_plan","code":"cff_subset_plan cff_plan; if (!cff_plan.create (acc, plan)) return false;","note":"A temporary CFF subsetting plan is built from the parsed source and the requested glyph set."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/hb-subset-cff1.cc","function":"cff_subset_plan::create","line":694,"var":"subr_subsetter","code":"if (!subr_subsetter.subset (acc, plan->glyphs, plan->drop_hints)) return false;","note":"The subroutine subsetter parses attacker-controlled charstrings and subroutines into heap-backed containers."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/hb-subset-cff-common.hh","function":"SubrSubsetter::subset","line":632,"var":"parsed_charstrings / parsed_global_subrs / parsed_local_subrs","code":"parsed_charstrings.init (glyphs.len); parsed_global_subrs.init (acc.globalSubrs->count); parsed_local_subrs.resize (acc.fdCount);","note":"The parsed containers are allocated and resized to hold per-glyph and per-subroutine state."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/hb-subset-cff-common.hh","function":"SubrSubsetter::subset","line":646,"var":"parsed_charstring","code":"collect_subrs (acc, glyph, fd, str, param);","note":"Each glyph's charstring is walked and recorded, tying attacker input to the parsed heap objects."},
  {"step":10,"file":"src/hb-subset-cff-common.hh","function":"SubrSubsetter::~SubrSubsetter","line":626,"var":"parsed_charstrings / parsed_global_subrs / parsed_local_subrs","code":"parsed_charstrings.fini_deep (); parsed_global_subrs.fini_deep (); parsed_local_subrs.fini_deep ();","note":"When the temporary subsetter is destroyed, it deep-frees the parsed containers and their nested allocations."},
  {"step":11,"file":"src/hb-vector.hh","function":"hb_vector_t::fini","line":52,"var":"arrayZ_","code":"if (arrayZ_) free (arrayZ_);","note":"The vector backing store is released after element finalization, so any stale alias to the same heap region can trigger a double free."}
